atoms.name: Base and limit relocation
atoms.one_line: Check offset < limit, then add base; protects and relocates one contiguous block.

atoms.name: Contiguous allocation and holes
atoms.one_line: Each process gets one block; free memory becomes holes that split and merge.

atoms.name: Placement policies
atoms.one_line: First, next, best (smallest adequate), worst (largest) fit choose among holes.

atoms.name: Fragmentation and compaction
atoms.one_line: External: waste in holes between blocks. Internal: waste inside a block. Compaction merges holes.

atoms.name: Paging basics
atoms.one_line: Fixed frames and a page table; address splits into page number and offset; only internal waste.

atoms.name: Segmentation
atoms.one_line: Variable-size segments with (base, limit) per segment; trap if offset >= limit; external waste.

atoms.name: Page size trade-off
atoms.one_line: Big pages shrink the table but waste more; optimum p = sqrt(2se).
